title: 🌀 Pseudo-3D Spaces

current_candidate.summary: Spaces v24 rebuilds Map 5 as a broad ritual avenue rather than a thin bridge. The camera rides a wide continuous striped path with dark shoulders. Alternating violet columns now flank the avenue close to its edges, extend from Y=-30 to Y=34/41, are near-black deep below and progressively lighter toward the top, and frequently leave the frame. Hidden-hinge giant signs and the strict two-visible-sign cap are preserved.

open_feedback: Review Map 5 composition: it must read immediately as a broad avenue between columns, not a narrow bridge.
Review column monumentality: shafts should clearly extend far below and far above the frame.
Review vertical shading: abyss-dark at the bottom, brighter violet above.
Review column spacing: columns should flank the route closely enough to define it without blocking the camera path.
Verify giant signs still disappear behind columns and never exceed two visible at once.
